Alessandro Schopf.note: Schöpf is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Alessandro Schopf.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Alexander Prass.note: Prass is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Alexander Prass.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Alexander Schlager.note: Schlager's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Alexander Schlager.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Carney Chukwuemeka.note: Chukwuemeka's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Carney Chukwuemeka.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

David Affengruber.note: Affengruber's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
David Affengruber.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

David Alaba.note: Alaba's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
David Alaba.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Dejan Ljubicic.note: Ljubičić stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Dejan Ljubicic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Florian Grillitsch.note: Watch Grillitsch for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Florian Grillitsch.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Florian Wiegele.note: Wiegele's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Florian Wiegele.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Kevin Danso.note: Danso stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Kevin Danso.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Konrad Laimer.note: Laimer is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Konrad Laimer.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Marcel Sabitzer.note: Sabitzer stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Marcel Sabitzer.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Marco Friedl.note: Watch Friedl for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.

Marko Arnautovic.note: Arnautović is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Marko Arnautovic.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Michael Gregoritsch.note: Watch Gregoritsch for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift.
Michael Gregoritsch.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Michael Svoboda.note: Svoboda's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Michael Svoboda.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。
